args.body: Dear landlord, thank you for your email. Apologies: our summary of 17 Feb said no issues were found, but the attached report does record two points: (1) a dog flap has been installed in the utility room/back door, and (2) sticker-type marks from command strips on the Bedroom 1 wall, which the tenant should remove and make good. Our records do not show that consent was given for the dog flap, nor any lock change. We are asking the tenant today whether they had permission for the flap, and who changed the lock, when, and where the spare front door key is. We have asked for a spare key to be brought to the agency by 25 Feb. Please tell us if you gave consent for either, and whether you want the dog flap retained or removed. We will update you by 22 Feb. Also, your email was signed with a different name to the one on our records; please confirm who we are dealing with.

Under the tenancy's alterations and pets clauses this needs the landlord's consent, so did you get it, and from whom? (2) Our records don't show a lock change on the front door. Was it changed, by whom and when? Please could a spare key be brought to our office by 25 Feb. (3) There are sticker marks (like command strip tabs) on the Bedroom 1 wall by the window; please remove them and make good. Nothing is decided about the dog flap yet; we're checking with the landlord and will update you by 22 Feb. Thanks.
